title: CYBRIK data marking v1
description: Structured, authoritative data-handling marking carried inside typed payloads (the envelope `marking` scalar is only a filtering copy of this). Vendor-neutral. NOTE (compatibility): the SOC canonical Alert/Case/Audit tables do not yet carry a TLP/classification field; a three-level sensitivity marking exists only in the SOC UEBA module. Mapping SOC objects into this marking is a forward requirement recorded in the compatibility manifest. Status: PROPOSED — NOT ACCEPTED.

origin_marking.description: Optional opaque source-native marking preserved for provenance (e.g. a product-local sensitivity label), carried without reinterpretation.
